proofs.race_free:
by
  have hmem : ∀ l : Location,
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).memory l = some () := by
    intro l
    simp only [initial]
    by_cases hg : l.space = Space.global ∧ l.owner = 0
    · obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hg
      rcases h : layout.global[l.buffer]? with _ | b
      · simp [h]
      · rcases hr : b.role with _ | _ | _
        · simp [h, hr, initial]
        · simp [h, hr]
        · simp [h, hr]
    · simp [hg]
  have hrun : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) = some finalUnit := by
    rfl
  obtain ⟨final, hsome, htrace⟩ := race_free
  refine ⟨final, hsome, ?_⟩
  rw [htrace]
  decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rw [finalState, Option.getD_some]
    exact race_free_of_run
  · rw [finalState, Option.getD_some]
    exact extract_final ops input outside
